conditions: Eligible to register as a voter under the Provincial Elections Act
Owner of land within the relevant district or electoral zone, or authorized agent of a board/corporation that owns such land, or a specified legal representative of a landowner
original_elector_profile.legal_representatives_as_described: Representatives of an owner who has died, become insolvent, or been adjudged within the historical mental-incapacity wording of the instrument.
original_elector_profile.candidate_rule_default: Qualified voters are also eligible trustee candidates, subject to instrument-specific exceptions below.
original_elector_profile.limits: This is the rule in each original Letters Patent at its date. Later amendments were not exhaustively reviewed. It is not a universal provincial-population electorate. Provincial-voter eligibility is a cross-reference, not an independent reconstruction of all residence or franchise exclusions.

qualifications: All 25 starts rest on original incorporation instruments;23 ends/transfers are in OIC3082/1969; two later cases have certified onward-transfer resolutions.
The corporations are distinct from hospital societies, regional hospital districts, and later health authorities.
